photographs and documents. Besides, as a general OCR-2.0 model, GOT can handle more tasks, 2.8,
sheet music, molecular formulas, easy geometric shapes, charts, etc. Moreover; the model can adapt
to region-focus OCR, high-resolution OCR, and multiple-page OCR. GOT mainly supports English
and Chinese and can control the structure results (Mathpix markdownltikzlsmiles/kern) via a prompt。
